messages.subject: Project Lyra — completion checklist and signing
messages.plaintextBody:
Elaine, Martin,

We're ready to complete. The completion checklist is attached. Please arrange for a director to sign the Patent and Know-How Licence (execution version), the disclosure letter and the know-how side letter. Marrick's board authority is confirmed. We're targeting completion on 27 June. Martin — the £4.5m upfront invoice can issue on completion.

Elena Marchetti
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Lyra — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Elaine,

Marrick has executed and we have completed Project Lyra today, 27 June 2025. The executed licence is on the file. Final terms as agreed: £4.5m upfront, £2m milestone (two £1m tranches), 6.0% running royalty, £750k minimum annual royalty from year three, exclusive within the defence/aerospace field, liability cap 125%. Congratulations.

Elena Marchetti
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
